hardinessNote: Hardy to approximately −20 to −15°C. Suitable throughout the UK in a sheltered position, although emerging foliage can suffer from late spring frosts and cold winds.
visual: A striking, weeping Japanese maple with deeply dissected, lace-like leaves in rich burgundy-purple to dark crimson. Brilliant scarlet-red tones in autumn.
soilWarning: Wind, drought and hot sun scorch the leaves
water: Water regularly while establishing, keeping the soil evenly moist. Water deeply in summer drought; pots need more.
prune: Minimal pruning required. Remove dead, damaged or crossing branches during dormancy. Avoid heavy pruning and preserve the naturally cascading shape.
resilience: Pests: aphids, Acer gall mites, caterpillars and scale insects. Potential diseases include Verticillium wilt and honey fungus.
